beverloo_fit — DRIVE granular op

• Data kinds: signal × signal × scalar × scalar → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.beverloo_fit(D0, W, d: 'float', bulk_density: 'float', k: 'float' = 1.4, g: 'float' = 9.80665) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import granular; granular.beverloo_fit(D0, W, d: 'float', bulk_density: 'float', k: 'float' = 1.4, g: 'float' = 9.80665) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("beverloo_fit"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

排出率の列 W_i(D0_i) に log W = log(C ρ_b √g) + n log(D₀ − k d) を最小二乗で当て、指数 n と係数 C を返す(真値 n = 2.5、C ≈ 0.58)。返り: n, C, rms_log(対数残差)。Raises ValueError: 点が 3 未満 / D0 ≤ k d の点がある / W ≤ 0。
